description: Read-only viewer for text art, Markdown, code and patches
notes: ansi.cat is the default app for text art and PETSCII files, unless you selected a different app in the settings of Windows.
pre_install: $registrationProcess = Start-Process -FilePath "$dir\ansi.cat.exe" -ArgumentList '--register' -Wait -PassThru; if ($registrationProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'ansi.cat could not register its files.' }; if (!(Test-Path "$dir\ansicat.exe")) { throw 'ansi.cat did not write the command line tool.' }
